sample_unit: de-identified psychiatric EHR cases used to build standardized patients
unlisted_practices: Simulating full psychiatric clinical encounters (S.O.A.P. workflow) with skill-augmented standardized patients built from EHR cases
Training domain-specific LLM evaluators (MentalEval) with rubric-grounded SFT and expert-guided DPO, validated against expert ratings (QWK 0.944)
Dual-track evaluation combining objective comparison against EHR-derived references with subjective process-quality assessment

screen.reason: The paper develops and benchmarks a simulated psychiatric encounter environment (MentalHospital) and evaluation suite (MentalEval) to test LLM performance across full clinical workflows, without evaluating a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
